title: An anniversary gift that tells your story
body:
Look back, together

An anniversary is the one day of the year that is only about the two of you. That makes it the perfect moment for a gift that is not about something new, but about something shared: the places, the moments and the small things only you two know.

Start with your places

Every relationship has a map of its own. The bar where you first spoke. The bench where you had the conversation that changed everything. The first flat, the city of the honeymoon, the street where you live now. Write them down before you choose a gift. Almost every good idea starts there.

Six ideas for any year

  1. A map of where it began. The place you met or had your first date, with a heart on the spot and the date underneath.
  2. Your story in three places. Three small maps side by side: where you met, where you married and where you live now.
  3. A return visit. Book a table at the restaurant of your first date, or a night in the city where you got engaged.
  4. A jar of reasons. One small note for every year together, or every month if you are just starting out.
  5. The song, framed. The title and the date of the song that was playing, printed and framed.
  6. A plan for next year. A trip, a course or a project you start together, written on a card you open today.

How to design an anniversary map

1. Choose the moment

The place where you met tells the beginning. The wedding venue marks the promise. The street you live in now tells where it led. Pick the one that means most, or use more than one pin if they fit on the same map.

2. Add a heart

Place a heart pin on the exact spot. For something extra, crop the whole map into the shape of a heart, so the city itself becomes the symbol.

3. Write the words

  • Your names, for example Sophie & Daan
  • The date you met or married
  • A line such as Where it all began or the number of years together

4. Choose colours that feel like you

Deep burgundy with gold lines feels warm and festive. Soft rose and cream are romantic. Black and white is timeless and fits every interior.

5. Size and frame

For a bedroom or a hallway, 30×40 cm or 40×50 cm. For three maps side by side, three times 30×40 cm in the same frame. Our guide to sizes and frames shows every option to scale.

Order in time

Every print is made to order and usually arrives within 3 to 7 working days in Europe. Order about ten days before the date to be safe, and it is ready to give on the day itself.

More ideas for couples: see our anniversary gift guide.
summary: Whether it is your first year or your twenty-fifth, the best anniversary gift looks back at the road you travelled together. Six ideas, and how to put the place where it all began on the wall.
